messages:
Raj (Support): FYI — NorthLight onboarding stuck. Ingest pipeline failing with 403 when hitting our provisioning endpoint. Ticket #5482. Trial account, renewal in ~28d. Need CS to engage, possible renewal risk.
ProvisionBot: Alert: provisioning-service returned 403 for tenant northlight-01 (x5 in 10m). See /alerts/5482
Zoe (CS): Can you paste the last error blob and whether data ingestion ever succeeded? Are they on Dedicated or Hosted preview?
Raj (Support): Error: "403 Forbidden - quota exceeded" in logs. They were on Hosted trial. We saw intermittent success yesterday (~30% of attempts) then full fail this morning. Logs:
```
ingest: upload failed tenant=northlight-01 status=403 msg="quota exceeded" used=1050 limit=1000
```
Davide (SE): @Raj can you run the quick token check? curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision/tenants/northlight-01
If it returns 403, try rotate token in console and retry.
Raj (Support): Ran the curl, got 403. Rotation attempt returned 200 briefly but then back to 403 after 5 minutes.
Kelly (Customer Success Lead): This is high-risk — trial + renewal window. Zoe, can you own comms? We should offer a temporary quota bump and schedule a 30-min remediation call. I'll notify AM.
Zoe (CS): I’ll own outreach. Drafting message: "We see ingestion errors affecting your onboarding. We've queued an immediate quota bump while we investigate, and would like to align on a 30-min call to get you back to green. Available today 3–5pm PT?" Will include next steps and fallback instructions.
Davide (SE): Root could be bursty prefix caching causing overcounting, or a bug in quota ledger. I'll open infra ticket and try to reproduce with a load test. ETA 90m for first triage.
Raj (Support): Marking P1. Action items: 1) Zoe send customer note (now). 2) Kelly request quota bump (ProvisionBot / infra). 3) Davide triage + infra ticket. 4) Raj monitor logs and post updates here. ETA preliminary fix or mitigation within 2h. :white_check_mark:
Zoe (CS): Sent outbound message to customer, scheduled call for 3:30pm PT, copying thread. I'll post the customer response and sync after call.
